skills.name: adr-workflow
skills.summary: Establish and maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) in software repositories.
skills.compatibility: Works in any software repository. No special dependencies.

skills.name: analyze-coupling
skills.summary: Use when measuring or judging how coupled / brittle a codebase is — computing afferent and efferent coupling, Instability, Abstractness, and Distance from the Main Sequence, and finding components in…
skills.compatibility: Works on any codebase. The bundled script is stdlib-only Python 3.8+. Dependency-graph extraction uses whatever tool fits the ecosystem (examples below for Python, JS/TS, Java, .NET, Go).
skills.name: analyze-cohesion
skills.summary: Analyze the cohesion of a class, module, file, or package and recommend whether to split it, merge it, or leave it.
skills.compatibility: The bundled LCOM script needs Python 3.8+. It analyzes Python (precise, via AST), R, and Bash (heuristic) sources. The reasoning workflow is language-agnostic.

skills.name: architecture-pattern-advisor
skills.summary: Use when choosing the architecture of a repository — topology (monolith, modular monolith, microservices, serverless) or code organization (layered, by-domain, hexagonal, clean/onion).
skills.compatibility: Works in any repository. Richer scaffolding examples for Python and R.

skills.name: codebase-design
skills.summary: Shared vocabulary and workflow for designing deep modules.

skills.name: grilling
skills.summary: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design.

skills.name: handoff
skills.summary: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

skills.name: prototype
skills.summary: Build a throwaway prototype to flesh out a design — a runnable terminal app for state/business-logic questions, or several radically different UI variations toggleable from one route.

skills.name: r-package-dev
skills.compatibility: Requires R 4.0+ for tools::R_user_dir() (use rappdirs fallback on older R). No network required. Diagram generation uses DiagrammeR if installed.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.summary: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance.

skills.name: stepdown-rule
skills.summary: Write, refactor, or review functions using the stepdown rule: make code read top-down, keep each function at one level of abstraction, and extract helpers so the reader can move from orchestration to…
skills.compatibility: Works with function-writing tasks in any language. No special dependencies.

skills.name: to-issues
skills.summary: Break a plan, spec, or PRD into independently-grabbable issues on the project issue tracker using tracer-bullet vertical slices.
